title: Infinite Dungeons
description: Choose Sledge or one of six other heroes for a twenty-stratum descent with up to four players on one screen. Sledge is a quarry worker who swings a two-handed hammer. Expose a monster with your power and let a teammate land the hit for a Duo. Open the Field guide from the title or pause menu for help in English or French. Wind-up soldiers guard the Powder Magazine, the Retort Brothers keep watch over Stillwater Bog, and Captain Brain-in-a-Jar waits at Rock Bottom. Pick cards from a shared deck, pass weapons to a friend and collect three scroll fragments to forge a Unique. Beat the Captain to win the campaign, then see how much farther you can go. Play with keyboard, mouse, controllers or touch. Save a run and pick it up later.
controls: Keyboard and mouse: W A S D to move (Z Q S D on AZERTY keyboards), the mouse to aim, left click to attack, right click for the power, Space to dodge, E to pick up, open or revive
Second player on the same keyboard: the arrow keys to move (aiming and attacking are automatic), Enter or Right Shift to dodge, / for the power (! on AZERTY), . to pick up (: on AZERTY)
Controller: left stick to move, right stick to aim and attack, RT for the power, LT to dodge, A to pick up, open or revive
Touch screen: left thumb to move, right thumb to aim and attack (auto-aim on by default), the buttons beside it to dodge, cast the power and pick up; every menu works by finger
Card rewards: keep a card or spend shared gold to reroll the unlocked cards
Hero screen: C (or Y on a controller) adds an AI companion
Esc or Start: pause. M: mute. F: fullscreen, from the menus
